SELECT i_manager_id, sum_sales, avg_monthly_sales
FROM (
    SELECT i.i_manager_id AS i_manager_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
           AVG(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item i
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
    WHERE d.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233
      AND ss.ss_sold_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233)
                                  AND (SELECT MAX(d_date_sk) FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1233)
      AND (( i.i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
             AND i.i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
             AND i.i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9') )
        OR ( i.i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
             AND i.i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
             AND i.i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1') ))
    GROUP BY i.i_manager_id, d.d_moy
) t
WHERE avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) > 0.1 * avg_monthly_sales
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
